exposure: Pregnancy-related acute kidney injury requiring dialysis (PRAKI-D)
outcome: Admission to high-dependency or intensive care units
cohort: The study included all pregnant and post-partum women who were pregnant, in labor, or within six weeks postpartum with pregnancy-related acute kidney injury and received hemodialysis at Muhimbili National Hospital between January 2022 and December 2024.
finding: The study found a high burden of pregnancy-related acute kidney injury requiring dialysis, with a significant in-hospital mortality rate of 17.9% and a high proportion of patients requiring critical care support.
